_comment: GET /events/_mapping and GET /events/_settings on our production cluster (Elasticsearch 9.5, basic licence, 3 data nodes, 64 GB RAM each). The index takes ~40M documents a day from our app servers and is 6 months old. Two things happen daily: (a) indexing rejects some documents, (b) the ops dashboard's terms aggregation on `message` fails.

_sample_document.message: upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection termination while calling payments-gateway:8443 for order 88213004

_errors_seen_in_the_last_24h: illegal_argument_exception: Limit of total fields [1000] has been exceeded while adding new fields [1001]

illegal_argument_exception: Fielddata is disabled on [message] in [events]. Text fields are not optimised for operations that require per-document field data like aggregations and sorting, so these operations are disabled by default.

_access_patterns_from_the_dashboard_team.event_id: returned in results, never searched or aggregated
_access_patterns_from_the_dashboard_team.session_id: returned in results, never searched, filtered or aggregated
_access_patterns_from_the_dashboard_team.url: filtered by exact value and used as a terms aggregation key
_access_patterns_from_the_dashboard_team.status_code: filtered by exact value, and bucketed by range (2xx/4xx/5xx)
_access_patterns_from_the_dashboard_team.tags: filtered by exact value, one document can carry several tags
_access_patterns_from_the_dashboard_team.response_time_ms: percentile and average aggregations only, two decimal places is plenty
_access_patterns_from_the_dashboard_team.message: full-text search only; the dashboard also wants a top-10 of recurring messages
_access_patterns_from_the_dashboard_team.labels: free-form key/value from the k8s environment, unbounded key names, only ever filtered on a handful of known keys
_access_patterns_from_the_dashboard_team.customer.plan: filtered by exact value and aggregated
